question:
Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/pan-t-satoru-top $.limits[0].value: Capture shows only the direct 403 Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge). The clause that a pinned provider returns the guest listing is not in this capture; my fresh cfbr read of /api/public/settings returned settings JSON, not a listing.
- netdisk-pan/pan-iosrxwy-com $.free_tier.stated: Value says 0 root entries; capture shows total 2 (two directories).
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.reliability_note: Version, title Zlion, five dirs and readme (mount marked stopped) are in the captures, but the readme does not say the mount was stopped because of excessive downloading: it separately warns that excessive downloads will shut the site down.
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.free_tier.unit: Capture shows a guest user only; nothing states an unlimited allowance. Readme says unlimited speed, a different thing from an unlimited quota.
- netdisk-pan/pan-t-satoru-top $.identity_cost.kind: Evidence is from pan.iosrxwy.com, a different host from the record pan-t-satoru-top.
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.reliability_note: Quote proves only the site title. The because-of-excessive-downloads link in the value is not stated by the readme.
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.interface: REST answers anonymously, but the readme marks the WebDAV mount as disabled, so webdav is not a working interface.
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.verdict: Capture shows only that the host serves JSON. The verdict qualifies-with-caveat is a judgement the source does not state.
- netdisk-pan/pan-t-satoru-top $.limits[0].value: Same as c02: the 403 challenge is shown; the pass-through returning the guest listing is not in the capture.
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.notes: Five directories confirmed, but the readme does not attribute the stopped WebDAV mount to excessive downloads.
- netdisk-pan/amazon-photos $.identity_cost.kind: Capture says cookie auth and an Amazon Prime account; it does not state an email identity.
- netdisk-pan/alist-zlion-top $.binding: The readme threatens to shut the site down if downloads are excessive; no per-IP shaping is stated.
- netdisk-pan/pan-t-satoru-top $.limits[0].value: the unit was undone, but a later unit has changed this value since; now "the direct endpoint answers an automated-traffic challenge with HTTP 403; a challenge-passing read route passes it and returns the guest listing"
